campaign: Recursive self-improvement through constrained, content-addressed artifact improvement
doctrine: Design record, not live executable work. docs/plan.json remains the only dispatch surface; cmd/plan does not read this file. A thin roadmap command over a common Go owner may validate this record and emit a PROPOSED live-plan insertion, but never mutate or dispatch it. The governing principle: the model may propose increasingly powerful ARTIFACTS, but deterministic Go owns execution, resource limits, evidence capture, admission, promotion and rollback. RSI here is constrained artifact improvement, never unrestricted code self-modification, and proposal / evaluation / authorization / rollback stay in separate authority domains.
thesis: Overgo is a content-addressed population of artifacts with a promotion mechanism. Automated composition needs three missing operators: bridge, compose, and a runtime experiment control plane to exercise them. RSI depth is a separate axis -- how many layers of the stack are themselves artifacts under the same lifecycle. Phase D lifts that ceiling and is safe only because ground truth is externally sourced and unauthorable by the system.

has: typed training programs and policy identities
structured run, evaluation, decision and review evidence
findings, plan advancement, containment, gate evidence
changed-file gofmt and repository-wide go vet
repository_development.gap: Surface discipline now relies on the toolchain baseline, production-consumer admission, and net-negative automation admission; the retired observe-only readability analyzer did not own a failable decision.

runtime_experiment.needs: a plane that repeatedly creates, admits, leases, executes, evaluates, refuses, promotes, recovers and rolls back model descendants through idempotent state transitions. Distinct from the development control plane and not derivable from it. Phase 0 builds the minimum lifecycle; Phase E supplies enforceable authority and resource controls.

promote_refuse.owner: cmd/recipe activate, internal/recipe decisions, RepoDB storage

retrieve.gap: pool is the loaded model only; internal/server/analyze_tensors.go sources from characterizeLoadedModel

compose.gap: components + adapter + profile + recipe + checkpoint -> one executable content-addressed model artifact

experiment.gap: create/admit/lease/execute/evaluate/refuse/promote/recover/rollback a descendant under budget with a replayable record

metric.headline: descendant-generation-depth
metric.definition: Generations of self-improvement before held-out gains stop. Generation N built by the generation N-1 system.
child_beats_parent_requires: identical evaluator identity and data-split identity between parent and child measurement
margin exceeding the observed noise envelope for that metric, not merely a positive delta
multi-seed evidence wherever training is stochastic; envelope separation at n<=3 per skill.md Distribution Discipline
no critical regression on any other declared metric
resource cost reported (GPU-hours, peak memory) so gains are ranked per wall-hour
holdout query budget not exhausted for the split used; selection and promotion splits distinct
metric.computed_from: the experiment/generation graph, never maintained in prose
metric.reading: Depth 1 is automation. Depth 3+ with sustained gains is genuinely recursive. A plateau at 2 indicates the operator set is too narrow, not that the thesis is wrong.

graph_contract.authority: depends_on is the sole stored ordering authority. blocks, unblocks and prose hard-order lists are forbidden because duplicate graph representations drift. Human order summaries are derived from depends_on and never parsed as policy.
graph_contract.validation: Reject duplicate or missing ids, cycles, unknown dependencies, self-dependencies, and any row whose dependency closure does not contain every precondition required by its declared capabilities.

mandatory_preconditions.rule: Preconditions attach to declared row CAPABILITIES, never to phase membership. Phase is not a safety property: rsi-phase-c contains typed-controller-action-language and independent-rsi-admission, which define or enforce boundaries rather than crossing them, and a phase-keyed rule would reject both incorrectly. The validator unions the required sets for a row's capabilities and asserts containment in its dependency closure. A row with no capabilities declares that it neither executes, promotes, admits nor measures.

capability_definitions.executes-autonomously: runs GPU or long-lived work without per-run human authorization
capability_definitions.promotes-artifact: activates a candidate as champion or active recipe
capability_definitions.admits-without-human: admission decided by the system rather than an owner
capability_definitions.measures-held-out: consumes an evaluation split to produce a verdict

implementation_preconditions.rule: Every non-landed Go roadmap row requires the new-unconsumed-surface admission invariant. Toolchain formatting and vet remain commit-gate checks; advisory readability remains reviewer judgment rather than a permanent analyzer.
implementation_preconditions.why_not_depends_on: A universal commit gate is a landing invariant, not a dependency edge; expressing it in depends_on distorts experiment order.
implementation_preconditions.landed_exemption: Rows already listed in execution_order.landed predate this policy and are not retroactively rewritten. Candidate changes near historical debt are checked by candidate-versus-HEAD diagnostics.

roadmap_state_contract.authority: Roadmap state is derived from Git, RepoDB, docs/plan.json, active leases and verifier evidence; stored status values are snapshots for review, never dispatch authority.

states.new: design-only row not present in the live plan
states.ready: dependencies satisfied and isolated probe evidence binds the declared gap
states.in-flight: an active owner-approved lease binds work to the row
states.landed: Git and RepoDB contain passing completion evidence at the committed target head

roadmap_state_contract.projection: The roadmap command proposes only ready rows. It maps ready to live-plan status open, excludes open/in-flight/landed rows, preserves the declared id/title/verify, and never copies roadmap status verbatim into docs/plan.json.

verifier_status_legend.declared: verifier string specified and statically valid; it is a specification, not evidence that the named test exists
verifier_status_legend.probe-bound: an isolated, immutable expected-failure run selected the named check, failed for the intended reason, and did not make the protected branch red
verifier_status_legend.implemented: the named verifier exists and passes on a candidate head but is not yet landed
verifier_status_legend.landed: the named verifier and implementation pass at a committed target head with gate evidence
verifier_status_legend.note: A declared row may be proposed for owner review, but only probe-bound evidence makes it mechanically ready. Expected failures live in isolated probe evidence, never as a permanently failing protected-branch test.

items.title: Phase 0 -- minimum runtime experiment control plane
items.rationale: Build the minimum experiment envelope and lifecycle so no experiment result is unattributable or unreplayable; repository hygiene remains owned by the toolchain, consumer admission, and deletion-led review.

steps.title: Validate the canonical depends_on DAG, runtime safety reachability, Go implementation preconditions, cross-references, derived stages, cycles and verifier syntax; derive roadmap state from Git/RepoDB/live-plan/lease evidence and emit a PROPOSED docs/plan.json insertion without becoming a second dispatcher
steps.rationale: internal/plan/plan.go has no dependencies field; this record does. A thin cmd/roadmap adapter over a common Go roadmap owner computes readiness and proposes; cmd/plan and cmd/gate remain the sole execution authority. It maps ready to live-plan open, refuses live rows with unsatisfied mandatory dependencies unless an immutable owner decision narrows the authority claim, and never copies roadmap status values.
steps.constraint: advisory only -- emits a proposal, never mutates docs/plan.json
steps.bootstrap: This row cannot promote itself. After the Go-hygiene bootstrap lands, the owner manually authorizes its first insertion into docs/plan.json; every later promotion uses the validator.

steps.title: Derive a build-aware production-consumer census for changed declarations: distinguish production callers, test-only callers, mechanically recognized external boundaries and zero-consumer surface; report both commit-local and cumulative plan-slice deltas without enforcing a scalar size score
steps.outcome: Landed in substance before this row was dispatched: internal/codeprofile consumer analysis runs in every cmd/gate profile step, classifying production/test-only/boundary/zero consumers per commit and per plan slice (gate evidence lines 'consumer census'). The 2026-08-16 session recorded three live refusals proving the boundary classification. The named verifier remains a formalization opportunity, not missing capability.
steps.rationale: Start with the easier and more reliable half of refactoring automation: determine when consolidation is required and hand the model a bounded symbol/caller set. Tests are evidence, not production consumers. Reuse the build-aware source snapshot and profile owners; add no second parser, hand-maintained path table or composite quality score.
steps.acceptance: The census resolves declarations and references across active build contexts; identifies new exports with zero non-test callers, declarations reachable only from tests, and document readers or writers without an exercised production counterpart; mechanically classifies command, interface, generated, serialization, reflection, cgo and build-variant boundaries; and reports cumulative delta from the plan slice base rather than allowing a small cleanup commit to conceal a larger preceding expansion. This row is observe-only.

steps.title: Refuse candidate-introduced unconsumed production surface after the census corpus proves its boundary classifications; leave total AST, function, export and import deltas advisory and create no score, quota, exception ledger or historical-debt rewrite incentive
steps.outcome: Landed in substance: the cmd/gate profile step hard-refuses candidate-introduced unconsumed production surface ('new unconsumed production surface: ... REFUSED'). Three recorded refusals on 2026-08-16 (generation-record constructor, test-only helper, speculative constants) each forced a better design; existing debt reports without blocking. The named verifier remains a formalization opportunity, not missing capability.
steps.rationale: This is the narrow ratchet that removes dependence on model discipline: a complete staged vertical slice may add an owner and its real consumer together, but cannot advance by calling tests a consumer or by promising that a later row will use a public API.
steps.acceptance: Only candidate-introduced, mechanically proven unconsumed declarations fail. Existing debt remains visible but does not block unrelated work. Once this row lands, add it to graph_contract.implementation_preconditions.requires so later Go roadmap rows cannot land without the consumer invariant.

steps.title: Typed experiment/generation aggregate referencing the immutable identities for parents, components, bridge, training plan, data split, evaluator, code/kernel/environment, seeds, budget, run, outcome and decision
steps.rationale: Descendant depth is computed from this graph. The aggregate stores references rather than copies: RepoDB remains generic storage while runrecord owns generation semantics and existing recipe, dataset, evaluator, environment and decision artifacts retain their facts.
steps.caution: Keep the day-one schema minimal -- exactly the identities needed to replay and attribute. Extend from what the first experiments demand. Building the full envelope before the first experiment inverts cheap-test-first.

steps.title: Record every refused candidate as an immutable measured refusal decision; expose the refusal ledger as a RepoDB query rather than a second mutable document
steps.rationale: Audit trail, negative training signal for proposal-ranking-from-outcomes, and the mechanism preventing the system re-proposing the same dead end indefinitely. Reuse the existing decision lifecycle and keep RepoDB domain-neutral.

steps.title: Repeat deterministic claims and require agreement; measure CUDA numerical spread and derive tolerance margins from observation; require multi-seed comparison for stochastic training outcomes; classify every claim as bitwise-deterministic, tolerance-bounded, or stochastic-multi-seed
steps.rationale: kernels/cuda/ops_f32.cu uses 12 float atomicAdd calls, all in gradient accumulation paths (grad_lag_bias, grad_scale, dscale, d_query, d_value, d_beta, d_key, d_gate), with comments at lines 504 and 1835 confirming scatter-accumulate. Backward results are not bitwise reproducible. 'Two runs agree' is insufficient for noisy training outcomes -- that tests reproducibility, not reliability. Implement as a gate step, never as doctrine: the agent need not know it exists and the message arrives with context at the moment it binds.

steps.title: Implement the idempotent runtime experiment state machine: proposed, admitted, leased, running, evaluated, refused/promoted, contained, rolled-back; bind retry identity, heartbeat expiry, checkpoint recovery and reconciliation to immutable generation evidence
steps.rationale: A generation record describes an experiment but does not operate it. This lifecycle is the runtime analogue of the prepared/finalized gate transaction: interruption cannot create two outcomes, silently lose a run, or promote without terminal evidence. Resource leases plug into the leased/running transitions when Phase E supplies them.

items.title: Phase A -- complete the operator set

steps.title: Compile the training modality matrix from RepoDB objectives; run real corpora through processor/projector/codec gradients and modality-native evaluation; record all other pairs refused
Port adaptive FNS, latent, forecast, OCR, flow-matching, image-latent, and distillation objectives only through shared TrainingPrograms; delete family loops as displaced
steps.rationale: Prerequisite for composition-viability: a bridge adapter needs a shared objective to train against. Landed at 7de448b1 'Compile adaptive objectives through shared programs'; status is a review snapshot, and the validator must re-derive it from Git/RepoDB rather than trusting this field.

steps.title: Derive typed components from tensor name, shape, dtype, family and modality across the eight organ axes; persist as artifacts with lineage to the source model; classification only, no retrieval index
steps.port_source: adaptive_new go/extmodel/organ_schema.go classifyOrganTensor, classifyOrganSpace, classifyOrganModality, validateOrganContract, requireValidOrganContractForPromotion

steps.title: Graft one classified component from a validated model into another; freeze both, train only the bridge tensor through the shared Muon plan; require held-out gain over the unmodified target beyond the observed noise envelope, or record refusal with measured reason and failure mode
steps.rationale: THE PIVOT. Nothing upstream of recursive-improvement-boundary establishes that component composition produces working models, yet that step has the controller proposing composition candidates. Without this row a downstream failure cannot be attributed between a bad proposer and an unviable mechanism. Uses proven infrastructure only: Tier-1 transplant needs no profile synthesis because the target ArchitectureProfile already exists in the 135-entry catalog, and densecausal.TrainDeviceResidentFrozenLexicalBatches already proves frozen-parameter resident CUDA training. Run manually, human-reviewed, under a recorded budget.

decision_point.on_pass: proceed to Phase B as written
decision_point.on_refusal: the controller action space shrinks and Phases B-D reshape BEFORE being built. Re-scope to whole-model chaining (Tier 0) through internal/workflowrecipe typed ports, which needs no latent-space bridging, and re-rank the adapter tier against measured failure modes rather than deleting it.

outcome.measured: baseline held-out CE 4.849884; seeds 7/11/13 held-out 5.440103/5.441688/5.428838 after 6 bridge-only Muon steps; training loss rose 4.969914 to 5.93-6.03 across all seeds
outcome.failure_mode: optimizer step-size dominance at the recorded budget (derived lr, 6 steps, 64-token windows): normalized Muon updates overshoot the 1.84M-parameter bridge before it can adapt; graft execution itself is proven exact (zero-Up no-op and finite-difference VJP tests)
outcome.protocol: donor Carbon-500M layer-14 MLP (organ mlp_gate) into frozen Qwen2.5-0.5B layer 12; zero-initialized Up bridge; host reference; wall 14m01s; evidence in TestComponentCompositionViability log at the committing head
outcome.consequence: on_refusal branch taken: Phase B re-scopes toward Tier-0 whole-model chaining; the adapter tier is re-ranked, not deleted -- a lower-lr / longer-budget bridge retrial is a legal future probe under a new recorded protocol

steps.title: Make scratchmodel.Compile emit model.ArchitectureProfile rather than a private Config, so constructed and inherited components are interchangeable in the vocabulary the executor already runs
steps.rationale: The keystone join, currently unnamed and on the critical path. internal/scratchmodel does not import internal/model; ArchitectureProfile is never constructed at runtime. controller-promotion needs a controller both scratch-built and executable through the shared runtime.

steps.title: Populate the store component catalog across every validated model and repoint the similarity endpoint at the store pool so retrieval is cross-model and inspectable
steps.cost: near-zero if cmd/model-characterize is folded into the in-progress validation pass
steps.rationale: analyze_tensors.go:113 sources its pool from characterizeLoadedModel, so similarity is within-model only. The pool source changes, the algorithm does not.

steps.title: Convert retrieval output into blocked composition candidates carrying required verifier, promotion-blocked state and blocker reason; advisory by construction, never authorizing
steps.port_source: adaptive_new go/extmodel/hdc.go CandidateRecipeBridges; verifiers organ_contract_parity / universal_optimizer_bridge_parity / paired_bridge_semantic

steps.title: Given a blocked candidate, derive adapter geometry, train it with everything else frozen, and emit promotion evidence or a refusal record with measured reason
Assemble components, adapter, architecture profile, recipe and checkpoint into one executable content-addressed model artifact with full lineage to every input
steps.rationale: Revision 1 listed compose as missing and never closed it. A trained adapter is not an assembled model; without this row nothing produces the descendant artifact that descendant-improvement measures.

steps.title: Port the bit-packed hypervector index with catalog-derived signature width, combining the lexical organ signal with the existing distributional signal
steps.rationale: Deliberately last in phase B. Do not automate selection before composition-viability establishes that selection matters and hand-run bridges reveal what ranking needs. The signals are complementary: lexical says what a tensor is called, distributional says how it behaves.

items.title: Phase C -- close the capability loop

steps.title: Define an allowlisted artifact-transformation action language the controller emits; deterministic Go executors compile those actions through recipes, neutral operators and shared training programs. No code, no shell, no arbitrary runtime orchestration
steps.rationale: The automation boundary. A controller emitting code or shell is unrestricted self-modification wearing a recipe costume.

steps.title: Construct and train the small workflow controller from scratch; immutable Git/RepoDB corpus rather than operational-state text; typed component and workflow actions; held-out action/modality validity and multi-seed gains; pretrained challengers under the same suite; champion/challenger promotion and rollback external to the model
steps.live_plan_conflict: This row is dispatched in docs/plan.json now, but independent-rsi-admission does not exist. Until it does, 'champion/challenger promotion and rollback external to the model' is a naming convention rather than an enforced authority boundary. Either land independent-rsi-admission first or record explicitly that this controller's promotion is owner-authorized and not machine-separated.

steps.title: Bind proposer, evaluator and decider to distinct authority domains rather than merely distinct artifact IDs; re-evaluate from a clean worker against sealed inputs; require generation N-1 authority to approve generation N evaluator or policy changes
steps.rationale: Distinct artifact IDs do not prevent a single process from authoring all three. Authority separation and the no-self-approval generation edge must be enforced in immutable runtime evidence, not by naming or doctrine.

steps.title: Permit bounded controller-driven descendant trials: controller proposes corpus, recipe, evaluator and composition candidates; independent admission, held-out evaluation, promotion and rollback required; every child bound to parent model, data, recipe, code, evaluator, run and decision identities
steps.note: Host-only verify: this validates the lineage and admission CONTRACT, not that improvement occurred. descendant-improvement tests the outcome.

steps.title: Require a child artifact to beat its parent under the full metric contract: identical evaluator and split identities, margin beyond observed noise, multi-seed where stochastic, no critical regression, resource cost reported, holdout query budget respected
steps.rationale: First row whose passing means actual self-improvement occurred rather than that the contract holds. Generation depth 1.

items.title: Phase D -- deepen RSI by promoting operators from code into declarative, schema-versioned artifacts consumed by trusted Go interpreters
items.constraint: Phase D artifacts are declarative INPUTS to trusted Go interpreters, never executable logic. A candidate must never promote a new evaluator or gate using that same new evaluator or gate: generation N-1 authority approves generation N.
items.phase_capabilities_note: Declared once here rather than repeated on five rows. Expansion rule: a row's effective capability set is the union of its own capabilities and its item's phase_capabilities. This is shorthand for per-row declaration, not a phase-keyed safety rule -- phase membership still confers nothing by itself.

steps.title: Make the corpus-to-topology derivation profile a content-addressed artifact with lineage and promotion record, so the system proposes derivation profiles and is judged on the models they produce
steps.rationale: AdaptiveDerivationProfile() returns eight pinned scalars frozen to reproduce the adaptive oracle. Promotion to artifact closes eight magic rows by derivation rather than a better story -- the RSI loop satisfies Magic Discipline as a side effect.

steps.title: Promote an evaluator only if it correctly ranks a held-out set of models with known-good and known-bad outcomes drawn from the sealed oracle set, approved by generation N-1 authority
steps.rationale: The classic RSI failure is a system improving its evaluator into one that approves everything. Safe only because the ranking set is externally sourced and unauthorable, and because the approving authority predates the candidate.

steps.title: Make objectives composable typed artifacts; let the system propose objective mixtures and measure which produce better descendants
Train the proposer ranking on the refusal ledger so retrieval becomes a learned prior over what composes successfully rather than a fixed similarity function
steps.rationale: Where refusal records stop being an audit trail and become the most valuable dataset in the store: passed and refused bridges are labelled data no external source can supply. Must respect proposer blinding -- the ranking trains on refusal reasons, never on promotion or audit split results.

steps.title: Make next-candidate selection under wall-clock and VRAM budget a learned artifact scored on realized capability delta per wall-hour rather than an applied formula
steps.improves: how the system allocates its own effort

items.title: Phase E -- enforced boundaries; preconditions, not follow-on work

steps.title: Place goldens, evaluator definitions, promotion policy and champion aliases beyond candidate-worker reach through a distinct OS/service identity or remote protected authority; require external provenance naming the producing tool and version for any golden change
steps.rationale: THE FIXED POINT. Goldens originate from HF transformers 4.57.1 / torch 2.12.0+cu126 and pinned llama.cpp; fixtures/carbon_golden.json stamps its producing versions and llama_*_grad_golden.json carry torch autograd gradients. The system cannot author them. Every Phase D row is safe exactly to the degree it is ultimately scored against artifacts the system did not produce.
steps.single_machine_caveat: Same-user ACLs, an external mirror and a bypassable gate are tamper-evidence, not authority separation. Until a distinct principal or remote protected service passes the integration verifier, promotion remains human-authorized. Capability absence such as 'the loop has no current torch path' is not an enforcement claim.

steps.title: Separate development, selection, promotion and audit datasets; record per-split query budgets; prevent the proposer from observing promotion or audit results
steps.rationale: An immutable held-out set is still vulnerable to adaptive overfitting through repeated querying -- immutability of the DATA does not bound information leakage from repeated QUERIES. Query budgets plus proposer blinding are the actual controls. Reuse the common typed budget accounting owner also consumed by exploration budgets rather than implementing split-local counters.

steps.title: Issue GPU-hour budget tokens for autonomous proposal; enforce cancellation and containment; exceeding a budget requires an external decision
steps.rationale: Bounded autonomy is the only kind that can be left running unattended. Query counts, GPU-hours and later resource dimensions use one common immutable budget/token mechanism with typed units, owner, subject, issued amount, consumed amount, expiry and external override evidence.

steps.title: Make reversibility a checked invariant -- immutable champion retention, compare-and-set activation, decisions carrying decider identity -- and exercise a rollback drill that demonstrably restores the prior champion
steps.rationale: An untested rollback is not a rollback. The drill is the row, not the invariant alone.

steps.title: Add experiment/job leases carrying GPU memory, CPU, RAM and wall-time estimates, heartbeat expiry, cancellation, checkpoint/resume, abandoned-job reconciliation, retry identity, recovery cost and actual measurements; recommendation-only at first
steps.rationale: cmd/plan -lease-report covers worktree/resource advisory leases for development. Runtime experiments need their own lease projection, but both consumers should reuse common resource request and measured-outcome primitives now that the abstraction has two real owners. Experiment-specific lifecycle state stays in runrecord; plan owns recommendation and capacity assessment.

execution_order.derivation: Stages are DERIVED from depends_on (stage = 1 + max stage of dependencies), then filtered to exclude rows listed in landed. Regenerated by the validator, never hand-authored; a mismatch between stored and recomputed stages is a validation failure. Stage numbers are dependency-depth labels, not global barriers: a row becomes ready when its own dependency closure is satisfied even if unrelated rows at lower stages remain open. Rows within a stage have no ordering constraint and may run in parallel.
execution_order.priority_within_stage: Stage 2: composition-viability first because it is the cheapest high-information experiment; production-consumer-census remains the prerequisite for the narrow unconsumed-surface admission in stage 3. Admission gates landing, not numerical design.
execution_order.bootstrap_exception: The owner authorizes roadmap-validator once; later roadmap promotion is mechanical.

open_risks: The empirical bet is untested: no evidence in overgo or adaptive_new that organ-level composition yields working models. adaptive_new carries the machinery and verifiers but no observed promoted bridge.
The derivation space may reproduce known topologies rather than finding new ones; derivation-profile-as-artifact would reveal this.

Every property measured to date is structural. The controls have never bound under pressure -- the promotion path has never admitted something unwanted, the evidence system has never caught a costly regression, the auto-close loop has never closed a finding. The one observed control failure (a stale parity-report P0 read as current) failed silently toward false confidence.
Velocity changes character past the port frontier: transcription-rate becomes discovery-rate, since neither inherited source has solved composition.

Phase 0 risks inverting cheap-test-first if the envelope or lifecycle is over-built before the first experiment. Keep records referential and transitions minimal; extend from observed recovery and attribution demands.

Sealed authority is weakly enforceable on a single-user host. Same-user layers provide detection only; autonomous promotion stays disabled until a distinct principal or remote protected authority is exercised.
Roadmap state and verifier status will drift if manually edited. The validator must derive them and report mismatches rather than trusting this document's snapshots.

Runtime lifecycle, lease and budget records can become a second governance surface. Reuse existing artifact codecs, decisions, run records and resource measurements; add no mutable ledger or duplicated fact.
